Sanders Slams Iran War
On Saturday, Sanders criticized Trump’s Iran policy in a post on
X
, pointing to rising gasoline prices as evidence of the conflict’s economic impact.
"Not only has Trump’s illegal and disastrous war in Iran resulted in thousands of casualties, it is wreaking havoc on the economy," he said.
He highlighted the national average gasoline price, saying, "The national average gas price has never been above $4 a gallon on Labor Day Weekend. Today, it’s $4.15."
Sanders continued, "We must end this war NOW."
